description: Repeated float4 window reads with raw GPU/host times and logical byte counts. Shared mode reads one window; private mode reduces the requested grid when needed so each launched block has a distinct window. Records requested/effective geometry, allocation and iterations. Direct unswept threads_per_block and blocks_per_cu overrides are recorded; distinct blocks do not imply CU/SM placement.

scaling_param.name: working_set_bytes
scaling_param.description: Per-block read-window size in bytes; sweep to study memory-hierarchy behavior

non_scaling_params.name: mode
non_scaling_params.description: shared = all blocks read one window; private = distinct window per launched block, reducing the grid when the allocation cap requires it

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
